name: Yasuki Toru
concept: Pregenerated PC for Wedding at Kyotei Castle. Technique types available: Kata, Rituals, Shūji.
demeanor: Acts the "absent-minded elderly person" but is still very sharp; chuckles a bit even when nothing humorous is happening; obsessive about his favorite pipe.

social.ninjo: Make the Crane Clan pay for what that they did to your family long ago. They refuse to honor your claims to your ancestral homelands.
social.giri: Make a deal to trade vital supplies in order to gain access to new jade mine located near Toshi Ranbo.

techniques.name: Tributaries of Trade
techniques.description: Once per scene as a Scheme and Support action, you may make a TN 1 Commerce (Water) skill check to establish that you acquired a chosen item earlier. If you succeed, you produce an item with a rarity less than or equal to 1 plus your bonus successes. You must still pay the price of the item. Opportunity+: Reduce the price you must pay for the item by one-quarter per Opportunity spent this way (to a minimum of one-quarter of the original price).

techniques.name: Weight of Duty
techniques.description: When you make a Social skill (Earth) check targeting a character, you may spend Opportunity as follows: Earth Opportunity: Learn one way the target fears failing as a samurai. Earth Opportunity Opportunity: Learn the target's giri.

techniques.name: Way of the Carp
techniques.description: As a downtime activity, if you have access to a market, you may acquire a number of items up to your school rank of rarity 4 or lower, or a single item of up to rarity 4 plus your school rank [2] (the item may be up to rarity 6).

peculiarities.name: Keen Hearing
peculiarities.description: You can assess your environment by sound alone. Even in darkness, you can accurately pinpoint the location of people and other moving objects near you.

peculiarities.name: Travel
peculiarities.description: You aren't unsettled by foreign customs, and enjoy traveling to new locations and interacting with novel things.

peculiarities.name: Sworn Enemy—Doji family of Crane Clan
peculiarities.description: The family responsible for keeping you from regaining your ancestral homelands!

peculiarities.name: Phobia—Horses
peculiarities.description: You have a debilitating fear of these large, unpleasant, smelly beasts. Being around them is disturbing and you're likely to try and make up excuses to leave if one is around.

gear.name: Wakizashi
gear.printed: Wakizashi (short sword): Damage 3/5 (7 DLS if 2 handed), Range 0–1, Ceremonial, Razor-Edged
